title: Finite projections of the normalized root-limit comparison
statement: Fix l prime and a scheme T with localizations, c over ULift(Q_l), restriction r and normalized coefficients k. Let H be a strict system, J a derived strict-system object with b:J≅H[2], t:F(completed root module)≅lim H, and e:H≅r.F(lineModule(c)). Assume the ordinary cone equation t.hom≫projection(H,n)≫e.hom(n)=k.lineProjection(n) for every n. For any normalized derived-limit models L0,L, the finite projection of diagonalShiftedSingleLimitComparison(F,L0,t,b), followed by evaluation of rootSystemTransport(r.F,lineModule(c),b,e), is shiftedComparison(k.lineMap(L)) followed by L.projection(n). No root-limit normalization, Cartier class or Chern arrow occurs among these hypotheses.

proof.text: Use hcone to identify the ordinary cone components. Apply the normalized derived-limit projection on the single complex. Naturality moves the b and e comparisons across it, and the exact single and shift factors cancel against rootSystemTransport. The comparison between right-derived-limit models is fixed by the shared derived unit, hence has these same finite projections. This proves the equation at n without assuming that evaluations detect arbitrary derived morphisms.

theorem diagonalTrace_rootProjection (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (T : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l T]
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)
    (k : Coefficients l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T c r)
    (H : DiagonalSystems l T)
    (J : DerivedCategory (DiagonalSystems l T))
    (b : J ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (t : (diagonalCompletedRestriction l T).obj (Scheme.purTwistZlModule T l) ≅
      limit H)
    (e : H ≅ r.F.obj (SpTowerClasses.lineModule l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c))
    (hcone : ∀ n : ℕ, t.hom ≫ limit.π H (op n) ≫ e.hom.app (op n) =
      k.lineProjection.app (op n))
    (L₀ L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod l T)) (n : ℕ) :
    rootProjectionEquation L₀.R
      ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod l T)).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
      (L₀.projection n)
      (diagonalShiftedSingleLimitComparison (diagonalCompletedRestriction l T) L₀
        (Scheme.purTwistZlModule T l) H J t b)
      (coefficientRootTransport l T c r b e).hom
      (shiftedComparison (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l T)
        (r.F.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ L.R) (k.lineMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) L) 2 ≫
        (L.projection n).app _)
